mapper.select: SELECT I.WAREHOUSE_ID AS warehouseId, PC.CATEGORY_ID AS categoryId, PC.CATEGORY_NAME AS categoryName, R.REGION_ID AS regionId, R.REGION_NAME AS regionName, C.COUNTRY_ID AS countryId, C.COUNTRY_NAME AS countryName, L.LOCATION_ID AS locationId, L.ADDRESS AS locationName, P.DESCRIPTION AS description, P.LIST_PRICE AS price, P.PRODUCT_NAME AS productName, P.PRODUCT_ID AS productId, W.WAREHOUSE_NAME AS warehouseName, I.QUANTITY AS quantity FROM INVENTORIES I, PRODUCTS P, PRODUCT_CATEGORIES PC, WAREHOUSES W, LOCATIONS L, COUNTRIES C, REGIONS R WHERE I.PRODUCT_ID = P.PRODUCT_ID AND P.CATEGORY_ID = PC.CATEGORY_ID AND I.WAREHOUSE_ID = W.WAREHOUSE_ID AND W.LOCATION_ID = L.LOCATION_ID AND L.COUNTRY_ID = C.COUNTRY_ID AND C.REGION_ID = R.REGION_ID AND I.PRODUCT_ID = #{productId} AND I.WAREHOUSE_ID = #{warehouseId}
